q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of an HDPE drum?
title: HDPE drum carbon footprint per drum
short: An HDPE drum is mostly resin: multiply the drum weight by the resin supplier's per-kg figure, then add blow moulding, cooling and compressed air electricity. Divide the unit's energy by drums passed.
audience: Blow moulders making HDPE drums and jerry cans

p: Report per drum by capacity and weight. Regrind of flash and rejects lowers fresh resin use.

example.title: Worked example: HDPE drum unit per drum (one month)
lines: Plant total: 42,600 / 30,000 = 1.420 kg CO2 per drum
Add resin for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
